The army receives 1 Cabal Point (CP) for every 500 points of game size. These points can be used to manipulate psychic powers.

Everytime a model wants to manifest or deny a psychic power, you may use your remaining CPs to select one or more of the effects below. Every effect can only be chosen once per battle round and per model. Reduce your CPs by the stated cost when using an effect. Your CPs get restored to full during each Reinforcement phase.
After successfully manifesting a psychic power.
Before rolling to manifest or deny a psychic power.
The range of the psychic power is increased by 6" per spent CP.
Add +1 to the test result for each spent CP.
After suffering a "Perils of the Warp" attack.
After successfully manifesting a psychic power.
Ignore the Perils of the Warp effect.
After successfully manifesting a psychic power.
After successfully manifesting a psychic power.
In addition to the power, resolve the effects of a "Smite" originating from the caster.

Select one of the following effects to apply to the caster and their attached unit until their next activation:
- Add +6" range to all ranged weapons.
- The unit gains +1 Strength.
- The unit gains a 6+ ward save.
